month-view.description: Six-week grid with events, tasks, and holidays, keyboard navigation, and an overflow popover.

drag.note: Drag an empty day span to propose a create, or drag a chip to another day to propose a move. Keyboard parity: arrows move the proposal, Enter confirms, Escape cancels. The lib never mutates the array — proposals land in the log below.

examples.note: Use the toolbar to change months. The grid expands recurrences, holidays come from the built-in provider, and the log below shows emitted events.

installation.note: Install the package and import the standalone month view component.

locales.note: Weekdays, months, and helper texts follow the selected locale.

props.note: Pass events (the lib expands recurrence without mutating the array), tasks, resolved holidays, and the display time zone.

size-density.note: Size and density drive the day circle, chip text, and cell height.

month-view.title: Month View
